query_plan.query: What is the total attendance across all matches in the 2026 World cup?

steps.merge_task: Return the tournament id of the 2026 World cup as soon as it is found.
steps.query: Return the tournament id of the 2026 World cup

dependencies.dependency: The tournament id of the 2026 World cup.

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by match, then sum all the attendance of the matches to a total attendance.
steps.query: Return all matches with their attendance, that are part of the 2026 World cup.

extra.sql_query: SELECT SUM(matches.attendance) AS total_attendance FROM matches INNER JOIN tournaments ON tournaments.tournament = matches.tournament WHERE tournaments."year" = '2026' AND tournaments.name NOT LIKE '%women%'

s1.sql_query: SELECT tournaments.tournament FROM tournaments WHERE tournaments.year = 2026 AND LOWER(tournaments.name) NOT LIKE '%women%'

s2.sql_query: SELECT matches.match, matches.attendance FROM matches WHERE matches.tournament = 5020214
